notes: Outlasting an endless maze with no way out is Survival, and The Backrooms is the reference behind its Liminal Horror preset, so the preset's interior-endless shape is taken as-is: corridors and repeating rooms with no boundary and nothing to reach, which is exactly what the answers describe. Dropped every option the preset carries, because spawner-npc and cover-los both exist to serve a pursuing entity the answers rule out and no resources were asked for, leaving the space itself to do the work; the preset name stays because its shape is untouched. Decided without a user: survival here is measured in time rather than at a place, so no gate-escape and no exit are placed even though the genre usually wants somewhere for the run to end. The small floor that loops after a few minutes is a scale note with no option to carry it, and the shape's P6 stays because a repeating maze has to connect coherently to be walkable at all.
